say:1:1130637001:1.text: It's been less busy around here since all that treasure nonsense, but it doesn't matter. I've made enough money.
say:1:1130637001:1.source_cn: 宝藏传闻破灭之后就没什么人来镇上了，不过不重要，我赚的...
say:1:1130637001:1.male: It's been less busy around here since all that treasure nonsense, but it doesn't matter. I've made enough money.
say:1:1130637001:1.female: It's been less busy around here since all that treasure nonsense, but it doesn't matter. I've made enough money.

say:2:1130637002:1.text: Work is supposed to be for building a better life. I'd be content if I only needed to build one more coffin for the rest of my days.
say:2:1130637002:1.source_cn: 工作是为了更好的生活，我希望余生只用再打造一副棺材。
say:2:1130637002:1.male: Work is supposed to be for building a better life. I'd be content if I only needed to build one more coffin for the rest of my days.
say:2:1130637002:1.female: Work is supposed to be for building a better life. I'd be content if I only needed to build one more coffin for the rest of my days.

say:3:1130637003:1.text: I'm not married, no children. Ha... I guess I'm not too different than the bounty hunters when it comes to going it alone.
